naming.note: every number below is read from the disk; the names attached to species and to creature kinds are chosen in this script from the behaviour in docs/spec/creatures.md, the manual dictionary and iso/spoilers/walkthru.txt.  The raw bytes are kept alongside as species, sprite_color and kind_raw so any name can be re-derived.

gift_giver.note: SPEAK checks that some object is still on the ground in the room, refuses a second time on the same day, and grants permission to TAKE one object of the offered class (or to REST in the nid).

hostile_animal.note: Touch pushes 10 rows of accumulated fall onto the player, which trips the fall-damage test on the player's next step.

key_revealer.note: SPEAK sets the flag that lets TAKE lift D'ol Falla's key.

merchant.note: BUY and SELL refuse anywhere else.  BUY grants permission to TAKE one object of the stock class.

pensable_animal.note: PENSE MESSAGES raises the spirit limit by 1, once per quest per creature, and counts towards the five that trigger a vision.

plain_talker.note: No special case anywhere: talks like any creature, never offers anything, and has no once-a-day limit.

ticks_per_second.note: the AI runs once per video frame, from the raster interrupt, independently of the player's own step period

banished.array: one byte per creature state id, 0-127
banished.bit7: the creature was hit with the wand of Befal: it never spawns again, its REST event is dead, and if it was a gate guard the door behind it is permanently open

contact.array: one byte per creature state id, 0-127
contact.bits_0_6: for creatures that talk: the day this creature was last spoken to (0 = never; day counts from 1 and is capped at 51)
contact.bits_0_4: for ambushers only: the time-of-day slot in which this ambusher last appeared
contact.bit7: the once-per-quest spirit gift has been taken: set by SPEAK for a blesser, by PENSE MESSAGES for a pensable animal
contact.note: the two readings of the low bits never collide, because ambushers have no dialogue and so never get a day stamped

gate_flags.gate_a_open: banished[52]; also set outright by offering a second wissenberry to the guard with that state id
gate_flags.gate_b_open: banished[53]; no dialogue path ever sets it

per_visit.take_permission: something has been offered; cleared by a successful TAKE
per_visit.door_permission: a gate guard was paid this visit; cleared on every room load
per_visit.falla_key_revealed: D'ol Falla has been spoken to; lets TAKE lift her key

sprite.facing: records are the left-facing frames; right-facing is a horizontal mirror generated at load time
